name: host
label: Host URL
help: Full URL to your Proxmox VE host including port. Example: https://192.168.1.100:8006

name: tokenId
label: Token ID
help: API token identifier in the format USER@REALM!TOKENID. Example: monitoring@pam!squaredup

name: tokenSecret
label: Token Secret
help: The UUID secret displayed when the API token was created.

name: ignoreCertificateErrors
label: Ignore certificate errors
help: Enable when connecting to a Proxmox VE instance with a self-signed certificate.
